key_insight: EDMD-kDL learns Koopman embeddings with a kernel-based autoencoder and bilevel optimization, avoiding a fixed dictionary while keeping the model interpretable and scalable.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical data-driven modeling route for forecasting and reduced-order analysis of nonlinear systems, especially when standard neural autoencoders or large kernel matrices are a bottleneck.
method: Kernel-based dictionary learning for Koopman embeddings
Bilevel optimization couples dictionary learning and Koopman approximation
Collocation-based formulation keeps matrix sizes tied to collocation points
evidence_signal: The authors report competitive or better performance than ANN-based baselines across experiments including global sea-surface-temperature forecasting and video data.
watch_item: Performance and scalability still depend on choosing effective collocation points and kernel settings, which may require careful tuning.
paper_title: Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders
